text.tspan: A CLI Mutation, End to End
tasks done <ref>: from argv through the store transaction to a journaled, validated, atomically installed file. The rollback message shows the failure path the same transaction takes.
Configuration is resolved before any store is touched; the ref must resolve to exactly one open task or the command exits 2.
Resolve config; refuse if unconfigured; dispatch
ReadSnapshot(true) under the shared lock; build
resolveRef: L<line>, exact id, then title
substring; exit 2 on no or many matches
own shared lock, before the write takes its lock
Patch(PatchRequest{state: DONE, expected: baseline}). Everything below runs while the exclusive lock is held.
PatchTask(id, state, DONE, expected, label, today)
wait, then refuse with holder pid)
fileSnapshot: raw bytes of live and archive (the
freshRecords: re-read and parse under the lock
Compare field baseline; MutationConflict if it
Apply DONE on a detached clone: closed date,
defer tag dropped, recurrence rolled if repeating
Dump: canonical key order, absent fields omitted
Sibling temp, fsync, copy mode, rename over
On any failure: restore(before) reinstalls both
files; result RolledBack with stage write or
Failure path. Validation runs before the journal entry, so
a rolled-back write leaves no history step pointing at
Intern blobs by sha, advance cursor, persist
index.json, garbage-collect beyond the undo limit
Headline from the post-write snapshot, or --json
